v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Benedíctus Dóminus * suscéptor meus et liberátor meus.
text.en: Blessed be the Lord * my support, and my deliverer.

text.la: Beátus pópulus * cuius Dóminus Deus eius.
text.en: Happy is that people * whose God is the Lord.

text.la: Magnus Dóminus * et laudábilis nimis: et magnitúdinis eius non est finis.
text.en: For the Lord is great * and exceedingly to be praised: His greatness has no end.

text.la: O Altitúdo divitiárum sapiéntiæ, et sciéntiæ Dei, quam incomprehensibília sunt iudícia eius, et investigábiles viæ eius!
text.en: O the depth of the riches of the wisdom and of the knowledge of God! How incomprehensible are his judgments, and how unsearchable his ways!

v.la: Vespertína orátio ascéndat ad te, Dómine.
v.en: Let the evening prayer ascend unto thee, O Lord.

r.la: Et descéndat super nos misericórdia tua.
r.en: And let there descend upon us thy mercy.

text.la: Dum tólleret Dóminus * Elíam per túrbinem in cælum, Eliséus clamábat: Pater mi, currus Israël et auríga eius.
text.en: When the Lord would take up * Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, Elisha cried, and said: My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.

text.la: Páteant aures misericórdiæ tuæ, Dómine, précibus supplicántium: et, ut peténtibus desideráta concédas; fac eos, quæ tibi sunt plácita, postuláre.
text.en: Let thy merciful ears, O Lord, be open to the prayers of thy humble servants; and, that they may obtain their petitions, make them to ask such things as shall please thee.
